experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification' (DR-005, amended by DR-006) row 'PSRR' (> 60 dB DC-1 kHz target; > 30 dB @ 1 MHz stretch, out of scope for wave 1 per DR-001), for the 3.3 V primary flavor. Measures design/bandgap_core.sch open-circuit with a 1 V AC magnitude on the supply, so v(vref) is the supply-to-reference transfer function and PSRR = -db(v(vref)). The DC-1 kHz band claim is verified at both band edges (0.1 Hz and 1 kHz): rejection is monotonically decreasing with frequency across every one of the 45 PVT corners on file (see records), so the 1 kHz edge is the band's worst case and a pass there implies a pass over the whole band.
experiment.title: Power-supply rejection ratio, DC-1 kHz band + 1 MHz spot, untrimmed core

spread_checks.note: DC rejection must move by at least 0.5 dB across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat result would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator.
